name: Geojit Financial Services Ltd
title: Geojit Financial Services Ltd - 532285 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Geojit is spending through a 20% sales-force expansion (about 650 sales hires, INR29 crore cost) and has paused field hiring, with FY26 profit hit by investment and brokerage income down while distribution rose; no numeric guidance given.

capex.quote: we have lined up about INR30 crores for the next 3 years to come in into the business

triggers.label: Sales force +20%, ~650 sales hires
triggers.quote: This 20% expansion in our sales force has an added cost of INR29 crores for the year

triggers.label: Field hiring paused for FY27
triggers.quote: At the moment, what we have done is we have stopped hiring for the field.

triggers.label: Mutual fund equity net inflow share 0.33 → 0.40
triggers.quote: Our net inflow market share in equities for mutual fund improved from 0.33 to 0.40

triggers.label: ROE outlook withheld
triggers.quote: Sorry, we will not give any future statements.

guidance.quote: we have lined up about INR30 crores for the next 3 years to come in into the business
We intend to hire around 25 to 30 relationship manager in this financial year.
We expect the new salespeople to break-in within 12 to 18 months.

prior_guidance_check.metric: DIFC AUM and advisory target of INR20,000 crores

red_flags.label: Brokerage income down; profit hit by investment
red_flags.quote: a substantial portion, which comes from brokerage went down. So that is why you have seen an effect on ROE being reduced.

red_flags.label: West Asia conflict stalls client decisions
red_flags.quote: clients are choosing not to make any financial decision at this time until they are clear about -- or they have some certainty about the future.

evasions.quote: Sorry, we will not give any future statements.
In the question of April, too early to say. Nothing much has happened in April.
I will not get into details about the cost per new client or the revenue per new client.
